idea-plugin.name: Kompoz
idea-plugin.description: For C++ sources with @Composable functions written in Compose's syntax (Kompoz's kompoz_compose): kompozc's language server, kompozc --lsp, in front of clangd. In such a file CLion's own C++ highlighting is turned off (it would read the Kotlin as broken C++); kompozc's errors, and the C++ compiler's on the translation, show on their own lines, and clangd's answers in the C++ around the Kotlin.
